summary: Handles the network game-list session state machine. On a get-game-list request (a2 == 1) it sets the scene-refresh flag byte_7CD2A0, queries the current state via sub_563E70, selects and debug-logs the matching status message (done/getting/searching/querying) unless the session is a server (dword_7C569C == 5), copies the selected string into the message display buffer byte_5EC4CC through BinarySearchInStringTable, and passes it to PathRegistryCallWrapper. Other a2 values only warn about an unknown game list or return a2 unchanged.

operations.description: On a get-game-list request (a2 == 1), set the scene-refresh flag byte_7CD2A0 to 1.
sub_563E70(a1) queries the current game-list state; the result selects a case through the jump table jpt_45D2FE.
State 0 selects byte_5EA438 (default application directory) as the display message and, unless dword_7C569C is 5, logs 'Done updating game list' through StringSplitLoop and DebugLogWrite.
State 1 selects the 'Getting game list...' string and, unless dword_7C569C is 5, logs it through StringSplitLoop and DebugLogWrite.
State 2 selects the 'Searching LAN...' string and, unless dword_7C569C is 5, logs it through StringSplitLoop and DebugLogWrite.
State 3 selects the 'Querying games...' string and, unless dword_7C569C is 5, logs it through StringSplitLoop and DebugLogWrite.
Default state uses the fallback string asc_5C5C8C, copied byte-by-byte into the message display buffer byte_5EC4CC.
BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, selected, byte_5EC4CC) copies the selected message into byte_5EC4CC when found in the table.
PathRegistryCallWrapper((int)byte_5EC4CC) resolves the path named by the current message buffer and its result is returned.
For any other a2 value (not 1 and not 2), when dword_7C569C is not 5, log the 'Unknown game list' message through StringSplitLoop and DebugLogWrite.
Return a2 unchanged on the non-get-game-list paths (including the a2 == 2 early return).

clean_pseudocode: case 0: msg = byte_5EA438;              // + log "Done updating game list"
case 1: msg = aGettingGameLis;           // + log "Getting game list..."
default: copy asc_5C5C8C into byte_5EC4CC; break;
unresolved: dword_7CD25C (GameModuleManager per existing analysis) is listed as read but does not appear in the raw body; it is likely consumed by a callee (PathRegistryCallWrapper or sub_563E70).
The exact meaning of the a2 argument and the a1 object type are not grounded by the packet; a2 == 2 is an early-return path with no observable side effect in the raw body.
The debug-log line numbers (239, 244, 249, 254, 266) passed to StringSplitLoop are literal values whose purpose is not established.
